verdict.rationale: The AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D is a desktop CPU, a physical hardware component rather than software. 'Running the product headlessly or in CI for automation' is a software-operation axis, so it is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence shows no headless or CLI automation capability for the product or its Ryzen Master utility; Linux OS support is a host-compatibility fact, not headless operation of the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
